initial_prompt: You are a Python coding assistant. Implement the requested function using the specified library. Return only a complete Python source file. Do not include Markdown or explanations.
update_prompt: Improve the coding assistant's persistent system instructions using only the completed training episodes and benchmark test feedback below. The objective is correctness on future coding tasks. Return a JSON object with exactly one key, system_prompt, containing the revised system instructions (at most 4000 characters). The assistant must continue to return a complete Python source file. You are updating instructions, not solving a new task. No held-out tasks or security-witness results are supplied.
